details: The package is a dependency-confusion stub: a scoped name mimicking an internal enterprise namespace, an inflated version (99.99.99) chosen to out-version the legitimate package, a tiny (~7.9KB) body, and a lifecycle hook. Its scripts/postinstall.js calls out to the command-and-control domain oob[.]moika[.]tech on install. The tarball was subsequently yanked from the registry, consistent with a publish-and-burn attack. The package is a dependency-confusion stub using a scoped name (@cloudplatform-single-spa/) that mimics an enterprise namespace, an inflated version (99.99.99), and a ~7.9KB body with a lifecycle hook. Its scripts/postinstall.js contacts the command-and-control domain oob[.]moika[.]tech on install. The tarball was later removed from the registry, consistent with a takedown of a malicious publish. A dependency-confusion stub published under the @cloudplatform-single-spa scope to impersonate an internal enterprise package, using version 99.99.99 to win semver resolution. The ~7.9KB package ships a postinstall lifecycle hook (scripts/postinstall.js) that beacons to the command-and-control domain oob[.]moika[.]tech on install. The package has since been removed from the registry.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
